settings.headline: Getting here
settings.body:
Helderwyn Museum of Making, 12 Mill Reach, Rookwater (fictional). The River Walk ramp enters the Entry Hall. Phone (555) 014-8800.

Coat check and the school desk are inside the Entry Hall. Strollers are welcome in all public galleries.
settings.label: Adults and students pay at the desk. Members show a card. School groups book at the school desk.
